title: Docs data executor
description: Write the docs data of a project (component anatomy and meta, or the options, mode collections and icon names of a theme) as JSON.

source.description: machines: one ComponentDocData file per component subpath of the built package. theme: ThemeDocData from the ThemeConfig (options and icon names) and the modeCollections export of the built entry.

outputDir.description: The output folder, relative to the workspace root. Its JSON files are replaced.
